title_zh: NABO 冒险之旅 · 八站离线游戏
description_zh:
把工牌变成一本可以玩的冒险护照，跟着 NABO，从深海一路走到月球。

跳过小镇的平台，潜入蓝色深海，开着小火车送邮袋；夜里追逐萤火虫，在两条岩线上交替攀登，赶在雪崩前滑下山坡，再乘热气球借风投信、点燃火箭奔向月球。八款离线小游戏连成一张冒险地图，让每次挑战都成为护照里的一枚印章。

【八站旅程，一站一种挑战】
• 跳一跳：按住蓄力、松开起跳，找准下一块平台的距离。
• 深潜：换向与俯冲，穿过海里的障碍，守住氧气，挑战更深纪录。
• 邮政快车：加速、刹车，对准吊架投递或补充邮袋；速度越快越考验时机，也要留意限速、红灯和牛羊。
• 萤火虫之夜：罐子的光就是体力。慢走、小跑、挥罐捕捉，金萤火虫带来惊喜，飞蛾和猫头鹰也会添乱。
• 双线攀岩：左右手交替抓点，两条路线随时换线；冰点要按住，碎石不能久停，看到落石警告就找另一条路。
• 雪崩速降：左右转弯穿旗门，冲上跳台后空中转体，用连击和速度把雪崩甩远。
• 风层邮差：看四层风向选择高度，提前把信投进屋顶邮筒，躲过树梢、鸟群和雷云光柱。
• 火箭登月：抓住点火、分离和奔月时机，再用反推把登月舱稳稳放到着陆台，迎接插旗演出。

【把成绩，盖成自己的旅程】
从跳一跳出发，拿到上一站铜章后解锁下一站。八款游戏共24枚铜、银、金印章，护照记录最佳成绩与已经走过的路；已解锁的站点可以反复挑战，随时回来继续。

六款横屏游戏共用新的标题、暂停和结算卡片，结算时看分数滚动、印章亮起，以及离下一枚章还有多远。跳一跳的蓄力与连中提示、深潜结算印章也一起更新。

开机有 NABO 的欢迎演出和“NABO，陪你冒险”语音。独立离线运行，无需配网、激活或小智服务；可调整音量、亮度、扬声器和自动休眠。

v0.2.0 为预览版，欢迎反馈实体手感、画面阅读和睡醒体验。B款换装选择尚未开放。封面为AI宣传插画，详情为当前固件界面预览、含演示数据，均非实物摄影。

项目与 FoloToy 官方无隶属或背书关系。源码与美术许可见仓库 NOTICE。
description_en:
Turn your badge into a playable adventure passport and travel with NABO from the deep sea to the Moon.

Leap across town platforms, dive past underwater obstacles, deliver mail by train, catch fireflies after dark, climb between two rock routes and outrun an avalanche. Then ride a hot-air balloon to deliver letters on the wind and launch a rocket toward the Moon. Eight offline games form one journey, with a stamp for every challenge.

EIGHT STOPS, EIGHT WAYS TO PLAY
• Jump: hold to charge, release to jump, and judge the gap to the next platform.
• Dive: change direction and dive faster while avoiding obstacles and watching your oxygen.
• Postal Express: throttle, brake and time your mailbag deliveries and refills. Higher speeds demand better timing; watch for speed limits, red signals and animals.
• Firefly Night: your jar's light is your energy. Walk, run and swing to catch fireflies, with golden surprises and hazards along the way.
• Twin-Route Climb: alternate hands, switch routes and read the holds. Hold onto ice, move quickly across fragile rocks and change routes when falling rocks are warned.
• Avalanche Descent: steer through gates, jump and spin from ramps, and build enough speed to leave the avalanche behind.
• Wind-Layer Post: choose your altitude using four wind layers, drop letters ahead of rooftop mailboxes and avoid trees, birds and lightning columns.
• Rocket to the Moon: time ignition, separation and transfer burns, then use short retro burns to land gently on the pad and celebrate with a flag.

COLLECT A JOURNEY
Start with Jump and earn the previous stop's bronze stamp to unlock the next. Collect 24 bronze, silver and gold stamps across the eight games. Your passport keeps your best results and completed milestones, and unlocked stops can be replayed whenever you like.

Six landscape games now share title, pause and results cards, with rolling scores, illuminated stamps and the gap to your next stamp. Jump's charge and streak feedback and Dive's results stamps have also been refreshed.

NABO welcomes you with an opening animation and voice greeting. Play entirely offline, with no network setup, activation or Xiaozhi service. Volume, brightness, speaker and automatic sleep settings are available.

Version 0.2.0 is a preview release. Feedback on physical controls, readability and sleep/wake is welcome. B-outfit selection is not available yet. The cover is an AI promotional illustration; detail images are current firmware interface previews with demonstration data, not device photographs.

This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by FoloToy. See the repository NOTICE for source and artwork licensing.
instructions_zh:
一、安装与开始

本页面提供与 GitHub v0.2.0 相同的完整安装包。点击社区“安装最新版”进行完整安装，会重置原设置与游戏成绩。如要保留存档，请改用 GitHub 的应用升级说明，不要用完整安装包覆盖存档。全部素材已包含，不用另装资源，也不用配网或激活。

下载及保留存档升级：
https://github.com/Liutupi/nabo-adventure/releases/tag/v0.2.0
https://github.com/Liutupi/nabo-adventure/blob/v0.2.0/docs/INSTALL_v0.2.0.md

开机后按OK从封面出发。竖拿工牌，上/下沿地图移动，OK进入站点；长按OK打开护照，在地图长按上键回封面。选择护照亭可进入设置。

二、沿地图解锁

从跳一跳开始，依次走向：深潜→小火车（邮政快车）→萤火虫→登山（双线攀岩）→滑雪（雪崩速降）→热气球（风层邮差）→火箭登月。拿到上一站铜章，才能进入下一站。

铜章目标：跳一跳10分；深潜100米；邮政快车150分；萤火虫100分；双线攀岩80分；雪崩速降300分；风层邮差300分；火箭登月1500分。银、金章继续提高挑战目标。

保留存档升级时，POST/CLIMB/SKY旧成绩与已获章继续保留，三款新玩法按新分数重新记录最佳成绩，其余记录沿用。社区完整安装会重置全部进度。

三、六款横屏游戏

从小火车开始的六款游戏请顺时针横拿、三键朝下：左为原OK键，中为原下键，右为原上键。中键开始；长按中键暂停，暂停后中键继续、左键重来、双击右键回地图。标题和结算页也可双击右键返回；进行中的右键手势不会退出。

• 邮政快车：左键按住刹车，右键按住加速，中键点按投递/补充邮袋。让邮袋吊架对准车门再出手，正中和高速有奖励；限速桥、红灯和牛羊靠近时要刹车。时刻表耗尽，本局结束。旧选轨、鸣笛和分步练习已被新玩法替代。
• 萤火虫之夜：左键按住慢走，右键按住小跑，中键点按挥罐；满能量时双击中键放光。捕获补光，挥空或碰到危险会损失光；光耗尽结束。
• 双线攀岩：按画面提示交替点左右键抓点，中键换到另一条路线；换线后手位可能改变。冰点需按住对应手，碎石点要快走。看到落石警告或前路断点，及时换线；握力耗尽结束。
• 雪崩速降：左右键按住转弯，中键点按跳跃；从跳台起飞后，在空中点中键转体。连续旗门需要横向换位，连门提速，漏门或撞树会让雪崩逼近；被追上结束。
• 风层邮差：左键按住放气下降，右键按住加热上升，中键点按投信。看风向箭头选择风层，留出信件下落的提前量；正中、金邮筒和高空投递有奖励。避开树、鸟和雷云光柱；燃料耗尽结束。
• 火箭登月：左右键按住移动，中键在点火/分离绿区按下，飞行时点按加速，奔月转移按光圈节奏操作。靠近月面点按反推减速，对准着陆台；燃料耗尽或船体归零会失败，平稳着陆后播放插旗演出。

四、两款竖屏游戏

• 跳一跳：按住OK蓄力、松开起跳，下键切换角色、长按下键重新开始；落空结束，双击上键回地图。
• 深潜：OK开始/换向，按住下键俯冲，单击上键暂停/继续；避开障碍，氧气耗尽结束，双击上键回地图。

五、保存、设置与预览范围

正常结束一局后保存最佳纪录和印章；自动测试分数不写入存档。护照亭设置可调音量、亮度、扬声器与休眠。首次安装默认扬声器开启，可在设置中关闭；默认无操作300秒休眠，按上键唤醒。内置状态页版本文字仍为v0.1.0，本次安装包以社区更新说明和GitHub v0.2.0为准。

当前已完成八款反复进出、暂停、自动游玩和存档检查；实体手感、实际画面阅读、逐款对局睡醒、音质及首次完整安装仍待实玩反馈，B款选择未开放。反馈请附版本、游戏名、横拿/竖拿、按键步骤和问题现象。
instructions_en:
1. INSTALL AND START

This page provides the same full installation image as GitHub v0.2.0. Installing with the community's Install Latest button resets existing settings and game records. To preserve your save, use the application-only upgrade instructions on GitHub instead of a full installation. All resources are included; no network setup or activation is needed.

Downloads and save-preserving upgrade instructions:
https://github.com/Liutupi/nabo-adventure/releases/tag/v0.2.0
https://github.com/Liutupi/nabo-adventure/blob/v0.2.0/docs/INSTALL_v0.2.0.md

After boot, press OK to leave the cover. Hold the badge upright: Up/Down moves on the map and OK enters a stop. Hold OK to open the passport; hold Up on the map to return to the cover. The passport kiosk leads to settings.

2. UNLOCK THE JOURNEY

Begin with Jump, then unlock Dive, the train (Postal Express), Fireflies, climbing (Twin-Route Climb), skiing (Avalanche Descent), the balloon (Wind-Layer Post) and Rocket to the Moon. Earn the previous stop's bronze stamp to enter the next.

Bronze targets: Jump 10 points; Dive 100 metres; Postal Express 150 points; Fireflies 100 points; Twin-Route Climb 80 points; Avalanche Descent 300 points; Wind-Layer Post 300 points; Rocket 1500 points.

A save-preserving upgrade retains the previous POST/CLIMB/SKY records and earned stamps. Their new rules use separate new best-score records; other game records continue as before. A full community installation resets all progress.

3. SIX LANDSCAPE GAMES

From the train onward, rotate clockwise with the three buttons below the screen. Left is the original OK button, middle is original Down and right is original Up. Tap middle to start. Hold middle to pause; while paused, middle resumes, left restarts and double-tapping right returns to the map. Double-right also works on title/results cards, but does not exit during play.

• Postal Express: hold left to brake and right to accelerate. Tap middle to deliver or collect mailbags when a crane lines up with the door. Centre hits and higher speeds reward timing; brake for speed limits, red signals and animals. The round ends when the timetable runs out. The old track-choice, horn and step-by-step practice are replaced.
• Firefly Night: hold left to walk slowly, right to run and tap middle to swing. Double-middle releases a burst when charged. Catches restore light; misses and hazards consume it. The round ends when the light runs out.
• Twin-Route Climb: follow the next-hold cue and alternate left/right hands. Middle switches routes and may change the required hand. Hold the matching hand on ice and move quickly off fragile holds. Switch routes for gaps or falling-rock warnings. The round ends when grip runs out.
• Avalanche Descent: hold left/right to steer and tap middle to jump. After a ramp launch, tap middle in the air to spin. Consecutive gates require sideways movement; chains build speed, while misses and trees bring the avalanche closer. The round ends when it catches you.
• Wind-Layer Post: hold left to vent and descend, right to heat and rise, and tap middle to drop a letter. Use the wind arrows to pick a layer and lead the rooftop mailbox while the letter falls. Centre hits, gold boxes and high drops earn bonuses. Avoid trees, birds and lightning columns; the round ends when fuel runs out.
• Rocket to the Moon: hold left/right to move. Tap middle in the green zones for ignition/separation, during flight to boost and with the ring rhythm for transfer burns. Near the Moon, use short retro burns to slow down and align with the pad. Empty fuel or hull damage ends the attempt; a gentle landing leads to the flag celebration.

4. TWO PORTRAIT GAMES

• Jump: hold OK to charge and release to jump. Down changes the character; hold Down to restart. A missed platform ends the round. Double-Up returns to the map.
• Dive: OK starts/changes direction, hold Down to dive faster, and tap Up to pause/resume. Avoid obstacles and watch oxygen. Empty oxygen ends the round; double-Up returns to the map.

5. SAVES, SETTINGS AND PREVIEW LIMITS

Best results and stamps save after normal completed rounds. Automated test scores do not enter your save. The kiosk settings control volume, brightness, speaker and sleep. Fresh installations enable the speaker; it can be disabled in settings. The default idle sleep interval is 300 seconds; use Up to wake. The built-in status page still says v0.1.0; identify this package by this update and the GitHub v0.2.0 release.

Repeated entry/exit, pause, automated play and save checks are complete. Physical feel, actual readability, sleep/wake within each game, sound quality and first-time full installation still need user feedback. B-outfit selection is unavailable. Please include the version, game, orientation, button steps and symptom in feedback.
changelog_zh:
v0.2.0 · 三款新玩法与统一界面
• 邮政快车、双线攀岩、风层邮差V2接入合集：速度与投递时机、交替抓握与换线、风层与提前量投信。
• 六款横屏统一标题、倒数、暂停和结算卡片，增加滚动分数、印章与下一枚章的距离。
• 跳一跳更新渐变背景、蓄力条、连中提示与结算印章；深潜结算新增印章。
• 萤火虫灯光衰减与滑雪旗门横移进一步打磨，攀岩和热气球的画面流畅度改进。
• 保留存档升级继承旧章与解锁，三款新玩法使用独立新纪录；社区整包安装仍会重置进度。
• 本社区包与GitHub v0.2.0完整镜像一致，仍为预览版。
changelog_en:
v0.2.0 — Three renewed games and shared interface
• Postal Express, Twin-Route Climb and Wind-Layer Post join the collection with delivery timing, alternating hands and route switching, and wind-layer mail drops.
• Six landscape games share title, countdown, pause and results cards with rolling scores, stamps and the gap to the next award.
• Jump gains a gradient background, charge bar, streak feedback and result stamps; Dive adds result stamps.
• Firefly light decay and ski-gate movement are refined, with smoother climbing and balloon scenery.
• Save-preserving upgrades retain previous stamps/unlocks and add separate new records for the three renewed games. A full community installation still resets progress.
• This package matches the GitHub v0.2.0 full image and remains a preview release.
